_comment: FX-ACT-01: extract_ids + 12 track_* helpers — one input pair -> appended IssueActivity shape each. Rows marked executed ran against verbatim-extracted function bodies (probe /tmp/fx_webhooks_probe.py + /tmp/fx_probe2.py); DB-lookup branches transcribed. Source: bgtasks/issue_activities_task.py:41-556. Common frame for every golden: issue_id/actor_id/project_id/workspace_id/epoch are passthrough; verb/comment/field/old/new per helper.

added.side_effect: IssueSubscriber(subscriber_id, issue_id, workspace_id, project_id, created_by_id=assignee.id, updated_by_id=assignee.id) collected; bulk_create(batch_size=10, ignore_conflicts=True) AFTER the added loop, BEFORE the dropped loop

assignees.keys: extract_ids(requested, 'assignee_ids', 'assignees') vs extract_ids(current, ...) — set difference both ways; non-UUID ids skipped silently
assignees.lookup: User.objects.get(pk=id) — raises on missing (no guard); note the dropped-loop variable is named dropped_assginees in source

closed_to.lookup: State.objects.get(pk=closed_to, project_id=project_id) — args recorded as call(pk='state-uuid-1', project_id='proj-1')
closed_to.none_input: closed_to None (or key absent) -> NO activity, NO lookup

row.comment: Pi Dash updated the state to

description.compare_key: description_html on BOTH sides (row field is 'description')
description.touch_instead: if latest IssueActivity for the issue (order_by -created_at) has field == 'description' AND str(actor_id) == actor arg: last_activity.created_at = now(); save(update_fields=['created_at']) — NO new row appended

estimate_points.removed: new None -> verb 'removed', new_value None, new_identifier None

row.field: 'estimate_' + new_estimate.estimate.type (CRASHES with AttributeError when new_estimate is None — port the crash, not a guard)

extract_ids.both_keys_missing: data.get(fallback_key, []) -> set() (no raise); a None VALUE under either key raises TypeError (not iterable)
extract_ids.precedence: primary key PRESENCE wins even when its list is empty: {'label_ids': [], 'labels': ['x']} -> set()
extract_ids.primary: input {'label_ids': ['b', 'a']} -> ['a', 'b'] (set of str(x), order not stable — compare as sets)

labels.keys: extract_ids(..., 'label_ids', 'labels') both sides; non-UUID ids skipped

name.row_same: no row when equal (including both None)

parent.invalid_uuid: current OR requested id failing is_valid_uuid -> SILENT return, no row (validated BEFORE the equality check; None skips validation)
parent.lookups: Issue.objects.filter(pk=...).first() each side (None id -> None, no query)

start_date.note: comment has a TRAILING SPACE: 'updated the start date to ' (target_date has none) — port byte for byte

state.invalid_uuid_coerced: either side failing is_valid_uuid -> coerced to None (NOT a silent return — unlike track_parent)

with_automation_flag.comment: Pi Dash has archived the issue

target_date.note: None renders as '' on whichever side is None; NO trailing space in comment (unlike start_date)
